reason: B offers the more plausible route to low friction across the full range because Ag can provide a low-shear interfacial phase, and it proposes direct film-continuity and tribology tests. A incorrectly extrapolates W0.5 results from an Al-containing BCC coating to ~0.5 at.% W in FCC CoCrFeNi, where formation of the claimed W-rich intermetallics and oxide glaze—and reduced friction at every temperature—is poorly supported.
